EVR-II-B-55

St. Petersburg Evr. II B 55, identified in MAM by the siglum ל-א, is a manuscript of the Prophets and Writings close to the Aleppo Codex. The National Library of Israel presents it together with its direct continuation, Evr. II B 247, but this crop belongs to Evr. II B 55. At 1 Kgs. 14:14 it has the silluq alone in this word.
